content: About-page guidance (Indeed, Grammarly, The Muse) converges: lead with current professional role/title since that is the first thing a hiring reader scans for to gauge fit, keep the bio to 2-5 lines / under ~200 words, include 1-2 accomplishments with measurable results, omit anything unverifiable. The Muse's 'include a professional blog + testimonials' advice is generic across professions and testimonials in particular don't transfer cleanly to salaried professionals with no client relationships.
